description: Models under test, as configuration (SCOPE-R9-model-config). One group per arm plus the judge: provider and FULL model id. Every group is Anthropic-backed and shares the same full id by default. Override with PARITY_MODEL (all groups) or PARITY_MODEL_A / PARITY_MODEL_B / PARITY_MODEL_C / PARITY_JUDGE_MODEL (one group); point PARITY_EXPERIMENT_FILE at another file of this shape. Precedence: per-group env > PARITY_MODEL > this file. Full ids only: no aliases (haiku, sonnet), no opus. Group C also carries thinking {"type":"adaptive"} (SCOPE-R10-thinking-parity): the native arm A asks the model with adaptive thinking, so arm C's request must too; override with PARITY_THINKING_C (a JSON object, or none to remove it); only group C accepts the key (A and B are the claude binary's own thinking, the judge is passed none); applied only by a round whose ledger lists SCOPE-R10-thinking-parity.
